checkpoints.note: The staged bytes at offsets 11..25 contain the exact substring `-----BEGIN PGP `, so `is_armored_source()` returns true and `stream_dump_packets()` enters the armored-input path by calling `init_armored_src()`.

First project-side materialization of the malformed armor header on the crashing path. This loop turns the staged leading dash run into a concrete candidate header length and pointer that later drive both type classification and `param->armorhdr` allocation.

Incomplete minimum-length check. This guard validates only that the reconstructed trailer would fit in stack buffer `st`; it does not require `stlen > 5` before the next statement uses `param->armorhdr + 5` and `stlen - 5`. The fix changes this exact predicate to `(stlen > 5) && (stlen + 8 + 1 <= sizeof(st))`.

ASan sink. With `stlen == 0`, the copy length underflows to `(size_t)-5`, and the source pointer `param->armorhdr + 5` points four bytes past the 1-byte allocation created in `armor_parse_header()`. AddressSanitizer aborts at this call with `negative-size-param (size=-5)`.
